description: Strands Agents agent run with one tool call, traced by Strands' default legacy events.
notes: Strands' default telemetry: content is on legacy gen_ai.user.message, gen_ai.choice and gen_ai.tool.message events, as Bedrock Converse blocks. StrandsTelemetry is given the harness provider. The agent sets trace_attributes session.id to s1. event_loop.cycle_id and event_loop.parent_cycle_id are UUIDs per run and are volatile. gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token is an integer in milliseconds and is a timing attribute. gen_ai.event.start_time and gen_ai.event.end_time are RFC 3339 times that shift with the spans.
